verdict.rationale: The porting docs state that everything in `skills/` is the harness-agnostic source of truth, shared verbatim by every harness, and that porting never edits `SKILL.md` files. A hands-on install copied a plain `test-driven-development/` folder with a readable `SKILL.md` and frontmatter into `.claude/skills/`, and docs note that `~/.agents/skills/` is recognized across Codex, Copilot CLI and Gemini CLI. Missing for 10: carrying skills to a new harness with auto-triggering still needs a harness-specific bootstrap injector, tool-mapping reference and separate per-harness install, so plain copy alone isn't the whole story.
